note: One plan for both sides, names swapped (tools/build_pack.py SCRIPT): the centre brigade advances on the village by the high road and holds it, the brigades either side and the second line follow it up, the horse covers the flanks, the grenadiers and the reserve guns stay behind; at noon the grenadiers go up to the village. For `script` players, whose orders Jev translates: stub-mode Jev reads every order as its first option, so a stub game of scripts checks plumbing only; stub self-play uses the doctrine bot (design-notes.md).
